|------|------|---------|
| `use_agent.py` | 11.7KB | Spawn nested AI agents with custom prompts/models |
| `use_llm.py` | 8KB | Direct LLM interactions |
| `think.py` | 17.5KB | Recursive thinking/reasoning tool |
| `workflow.py` | 48KB | Advanced workflow orchestration |
| `swarm.py` | 21KB | Multi-agent swarm coordination |
| `graph.py` | 27.5KB | DAG-based agent graphs |
| `agent_graph.py` | 20KB | Legacy agent graph implementation |
